candidate_bank.algorithm: Python 3.12 random.Random(seed).sample(range(1,46),6), unique sorted tuples, bank lexicographically sorted

change_policy: immutable V4; rules/weights/code changes require prospective_v5 or later; outcomes never used to tune V4

multiple_testing.family: 7 nonuniform models x 2 modes plus 2 portfolio modes
multiple_testing.primary_endpoint: mean hits; single tickets exact hypergeometric convolution upper-tail; portfolios conditional-fair Hoeffding upper bound

portfolio.selection: greedy in fixed model order; highest-ranked acceptable distinct ticket; fallback minimize sum overlap, then max overlap, then rank, then lexicographic ticket

prospective_eligibility: must publish each sealed prediction in GitHub before its official draw with independently recorded publication evidence; missed target is missing, never reconstructed after result; V4 invalid if freeze not proved prior to 1245 draw
relation_validation: diagnostic only; never veto extreme tickets or alter ranking
tie_break: scores descending then number ascending; candidate sum scores descending then sorted tuple lexicographic ascending
